landing.heroDesc: Enterprise-grade live video streaming that works on Wi-Fi, mobile data, or local networks. Optimized for Android devices worldwide — even on low bandwidth.
landing.multiNetworkDesc: Seamlessly switches between Wi-Fi, mobile data, and local connections. Works on 2G/3G/4G/5G.
landing.audioFallbackDesc: Automatically drops to audio-only on low bandwidth. Never lose connection to your baby.
landing.e2eSecureDesc: Encrypted video rooms with token-based access. Only authorized viewers can connect.
landing.twoWayAudioDesc: Talk back to soothe your baby. Crystal-clear audio optimized for low-end devices.
landing.smartAlertsDesc: Cry detection and motion alerts sent instantly to all connected devices.
landing.hdStreamingDesc: Adaptive bitrate streaming — HD when bandwidth allows, reliable when it doesn't.
landing.disclaimerBanner: BabyCam.io is a monitoring tool and is not a substitute for in-person supervision of children.
